svg.title: Conviction in admirable friendship & dhamma conditions heedfulness (MN 95)

g.text: Conviction in admirable friendship & dhamma conditions heedfulness (MN 95)
penetrates the meaning of those dhammas
reflect on failings of oneself & others
reflect on attainments of oneself & others
Gladly would I let the flesh & blood in my body dry up...
there will be no relaxing my persistence
admirable friend arouses sense of shame?
